title: Tree-sitter grammar for .michi
body: After the Vim syntax file, once the format has stopped moving. Needs a grammar.js, a C scanner for the command-to-semicolon rule under shell quoting, which re-implements lex.rs, generated parser.c, and highlights, injections (bash into command text), folds and indents queries. Conventionally its own repository, registered with nvim-treesitter.
